svg.title: SVG filter neural network
svg.text: SVG neural net: next-character prediction computed by your browser's filter engine
128 ReLU units, 5-character context, 8-bit integers, no code. Input = pixels.
hidden layer, 128 ReLU units (brighter = more active)
20 windows; each row slides a 5-character window over the input. Per row the browser runs:
one-hot pixels -> 128 feConvolveMatrix neurons (160 taps) -> feComponentTransfer ReLU/requantise LUT
-> 32 feConvolveMatrix logits (128 taps) -> feMorphology argmax -> feDisplacementMap glyph atlas.
Pure filter graph: weights = kernel numbers, activations = 8-bit pixels (bit-exact vs an integer reference).
Computes correctly only in Chrome-engine browsers at 1x device-pixel ratio (100% zoom, non-Retina).
